decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated the product feed which was heavily mixed with camping accessories. I narrowed the focus to actual backpacks and high-utility sling bags. The High Sierra 70L is a solid technical pack, but for general use, the ZOMAKE 20L packable daypack is much more versatile. Its massive review count of over 14,000 and high average rating of 4.6, combined with a very affordable price point, make it the most compelling purchase in this set. The vimapo and ABENAKI options were decent but lacked the significant social proof that the ZOMAKE bag offered.
